items: Apply the Strangler Fig pattern to incrementally migrate a monolith.
Place a routing facade/gateway in front of legacy and new services.
Extract one bounded feature behind the facade without a big-bang rewrite.
Verify routing correctness and measure the migration step.
Strangler Fig pattern — incrementally replace parts of a legacy system with new services, routing traffic at a facade.
Facade / API Gateway — the interception point that directs requests to old or new implementations.
Bounded context — a cohesive capability extracted as a unit (e.g., "Orders").
Parallel run — old and new implementations coexist; traffic is shifted gradually.

blocks.text: You have a monolithic "Shop" application with an Orders module you want to modernize into a standalone service, while keeping the rest of the monolith intact. Rather than a risky rewrite, you route /api/orders/* to a new Orders service and let everything else hit the monolith.

A reverse proxy (Nginx / API Gateway / Traefik) fronts both. Initially 100% of traffic goes to the monolith. You deploy the new Orders service, flip the route for /api/orders, validate, then decommission the old module.

items: Docker + Docker Compose installed.
A simple monolith (any language) exposing / (legacy) and /api/orders (to be extracted).
curl or Postman for testing.

blocks.text: Run a minimal monolith container exposing port 8080 with endpoints / (returns "legacy home") and /api/orders (returns legacy orders JSON).
Task 2 — Build the new Orders service
Create a small service (port 8081) implementing /api/orders with improved logic (e.g., returns enriched orders). Keep its contract identical to the legacy endpoint.

blocks.value:
location /api/orders/  { proxy_pass http://orders-svc:8081/; }
location /             { proxy_pass http://monolith:8080/; }

blocks.text: Route /api/orders to the new service, everything else to the monolith.

items: curl localhost/api/orders → should return the new service response.
curl localhost/ → should return legacy home.
Optionally set a weighted split (90% monolith / 10% new) to compare.

blocks.text: Once stable, remove the /api/orders code path from the monolith and update the ADR documenting the extraction.

blocks.value:
flowchart LR
    C[Client] --> G[API Gateway / Facade]
    G -->|/api/orders| O[New Orders Service :8081]
    G -->|other paths| M[Legacy Monolith :8080]

items: A working docker-compose.yml with gateway + monolith + orders service.
curl proof that orders traffic hits the new service and other traffic hits the monolith.
A short ADR (use the 4.1 template) recording the extraction decision.
Bonus: weighted routing config demonstrating a canary shift.
